sprint.name: Sprint 4: High-Fidelity Interactivity
sprint.goal: Q2 Portfolio Launch: Hardening backend security, establishing high-fidelity project metrics, and professionalizing the Localization PM roadmap

tasks.summary: Strategy: Site Information Architecture & Localization Hierarchy
tasks.description:
Objective: Design a scalable IA that accommodates multi-language project showcases.

Key Activities:
- Mapping user journeys for tech recruiters and hiring managers.
- Defining the global sitemap and content navigation logic.
- Establishing the technical hierarchy for localized project details.

Objective: Implement a premium, real-time interactive board to showcase PM transparency.

Features:
- Side-drawer (Sheet) detail synchronization.
- Live status and priority indicators.
- Automated sync hooks for dev tracking.

Objective: Architect a robust backend proxy layer for external service integrations.

Results:
- 100% credential security (Jira/EmailJS keys remain server-side).
- Elimination of CORS issues via centralized FastAPI endpoints.
- Implementation of memory-based performance caching.
